youtube.title: The bird that never lands: 10 months in the air without touching down ⏱️
youtube.description:
Albatross, Arctic tern or the third one? Scientists fitted tiny data loggers to a small bird and found some individuals stayed airborne for ten months straight — eating, drinking, even sleeping on the wing — until they came home to nest.
Guess before the map lights up, then see where the study was done, the plate that gets wiped off the screen, and the flight south.
Which did you pick?
